title: Scoring or retrieval service unavailable
content: A timeout or unavailable dependency leaves an explicit incomplete draft. A deterministic case report remains available. Retry only within the existing runtime, request and cost limits after checking the exact failed batch and idempotency key. Never substitute a different model, paid Search tier, region or unsigned artifact automatically. Input + release identity must match on replay.
check: Inspect the failed batch identity and dependency status; use the deterministic report and preserve the incomplete draft before any approved bounded retry.
